outcome: accuracy of routine register-recorded stillbirth rates
percent agreement between observer-assessed and register-recorded outcomes
misclassification of stillbirths with neonatal deaths
proxy value of stillbirth appearance for timing of death
cohort: The study observed 23,072 births, including 550 stillbirths, across five hospitals in Bangladesh, Nepal, and Tanzania.
finding: Routine registers accurately recorded stillbirths (specificity > 99%, sensitivity 77.7-86.1%), but fresh/macerated stillbirth appearance was a poor proxy for timing of death.
mod_finding: Percent agreement between observer-assessed and register-recorded birth outcomes was very high across all hospitals and all modes of birth.
